t0152-01.gloss: A course closure and meal delivery fall on opposite sides of a pickup.
t0152-01.rival_reading: A maintenance crew could have used the course during field work; the receipt does not say why the pickup was arranged.

t0152-02.gloss: Two course notices disagree about whether the grounds were ready.
t0152-02.rival_reading: A response crew could have restricted the grounds while checking a spill; the sheet does not identify the substance.
